tasks.label: FamilySonar: Deploy to device
args: $rawSdk = (Select-String -Path local.properties -Pattern '^sdk.dir=').Line -replace '^sdk.dir=', ''; $backslash = ([char]92).ToString(); $sdk = $rawSdk.Replace($backslash + ':', ':').Replace($backslash + $backslash, $backslash); $adb = "$sdk\platform-tools\adb.exe"; & $adb -d uninstall com.familysonar; & $adb -d install -g --whitelist-restricted-permissions android.permission.RECEIVE_SMS,android.permission.SEND_SMS "$PWD\app\build\outputs\apk\debug\app-debug.apk"; & $adb -d shell monkey -p com.familysonar 1
